name: Outline icon
region: Apple iOS 7, then open sets Feather, Lucide and Tabler
summary: Icons drawn as one even stroke on a 24 px grid, with round caps and joins and no fill. The set reads like a light typeface: the same line weight, the same corner radius and the same live area for every glyph.

philosophy.core_thesis: An icon set is a typeface of objects: one stroke, one grid and one corner radius make hundreds of glyphs read as one family.
design_principles: Draw on a 24 × 24 px grid with a live area of 20 × 20 px and 2 px of padding on each side.
Use one stroke width for the whole set: 2 px at 24 px (1.5 px for a light set).
Set round caps and round joins on every path.
Give rectangles a corner radius of 2 px; circles and arcs keep the same stroke.
Keep a gap of at least 2 px between two parallel strokes.
Align strokes to the pixel grid so that a 2 px line covers whole pixels at 1× and 2×.
anti_patterns: Mixed stroke widths in one set
Square caps next to round caps
Detail closer than 2 px at 24 px

grid.keylines: A circle of 20 px, a square of 18 px, a portrait rectangle of 16 × 20 px and a landscape rectangle of 20 × 16 px.

stroke.rule: One 2 px stroke for the full set at 24 px; scale the stroke with the icon, and use 1.5 px at 16 px when hinted.

shape.primitives: Lines, arcs, circles and rounded rectangles; angles at 0°, 45° and 90° where possible.
shape.optical_size: At 16 px, remove inner parts and keep the silhouette; the stroke stays 1.5–2 px.

colour.strategy: One colour: currentColor, so that the icon takes the colour of the text next to it.

perspective_and_light.shadow: No shadow; the glyph is flat on the ground.

metaphor.typical: A house, an envelope, a camera, a calendar, a gear, a bell, a magnifier, a heart and a folder.
metaphor.treatment: Reduced to the outline of the object plus 1 or 2 inner lines; no texture.

evidence.title: Lucide: house
evidence.credit: Lucide, a community fork of Feather; lucide-static 0.460.0

emotion.target_response: Calm precision: the UI feels light, ordered and quiet.

avoid_when: The icon must read at 12 px or less.
The brand is loud and colourful.

modifiers.how: Keep the 24 px grid and the shapes; fill the closed shapes and cut inner details as 2 px gaps.
Keep the 2 px stroke; add a fill at 20% opacity in the same colour inside the main shape.
